name: Stage Direction
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area: 10-ft.-radius burst
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Each creature within the area of effect takes 1d10 points of phrenic damage +1 point per caster level .

The spell also creates a zone that lasts until the end of your next turn. Each creature that attempts to leave a square within the zone must make a Will save against the spell’s DC. On a failed save, the target is unable to move from its current space until the beginning of its next turn.
